Configure current feature

  1. Apply base durable schema including containers, item_instances, inventory_stacks, shared container_occupancy, wallet, progression, receipt, ledger, outbox and character_sessions. Container identity exists before inventory UI09.
  2. Implement API_Admission, API_CharacterSnapshot and API_CommandStatus behind URPGCharacterServiceAdapter. A session has a monotonic epoch, lease expiry and current zone holder.
  3. Replace03 identity fixture admission with authenticated character selection and current snapshot hydration. Fail closed on invalid schema/content; do not fall back to local SaveGame.

Only place actors whose systems are active in this phase; later rows are staged expansion instructions, not a requirement to build all map content now. Keep placeholders labeled and preserve earlier test sections.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Select Character_A and admit to L_NetworkLab through the trusted development service. Seed one nonstackable sword GUID, wallet1000 and a stack of ore only through a recorded fixture command.
  2. Disconnect after a successful fixture mutation but before UI acknowledgment; reconnect and query the same command receipt.
  3. Attempt a second simultaneous admission of Character_A. Revoke the old lease through controlled takeover, increment epoch and try one old-session write.
  4. Restart GameService/zone process, preserving the disposable PostgreSQL database; hydrate a fresh PlayerState and body.
Expected success
CharacterId/item GUID/quantity/currency/XP revisions survive reconnect; one accepted command has one receipt and one ledger effect.
Only the current epoch may write. A timeout is Pending/Unknown until queried, never an automatic second grant.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Inventory screen/equipment09, loot allocation10 and production economy follow later. These are minimal identity/record contracts, not all game content.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

current-phase fixtureCorrupt required version or item definition -> RecoveryRequired/PatchRequired before enabling gameplay.
current-phase fixtureCross-container occupancy collision or negative quantity -> rejection/constraint rollback; neither half commits.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

One character lease; retry after a lost acknowledgement returns the existing receipt.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
